title: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
summary: Frodo Baggins inherits a ring from his uncle Bilbo and learns it is the Dark Lord Sauron's weapon. He leaves the Shire with companions to carry it toward Mordor and destroy it.
readIf: you enjoy immersive world-building and a long, journey-driven fantasy quest.
skipIf: you want fast plotting, since the opening chapters and travel sections move leisurely.
